description: MUTATING: start a new build for a build/combined service. With an empty body it builds the latest commit on the linked branch; optionally target a branch, a specific commit sha, or a pull request. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/build.

branch.description: Branch to build (defaults to the service's linked branch).

pullRequestId.description: Build the latest commit of this pull request's branch.

sha.description: Specific commit SHA to build from the branch.

name: northflank_trigger_service_build
title: Trigger service build (mutates infra)
